visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Pop Decrements Before Reading
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After pushing 10, 20 and 30 the first pop should return 30, but the program prints 20.

solution.explanation: top points at the newest element. top-- reads it first and then moves down; --top moves down first and reads the element below it. The newest value is skipped, and the stack ends up reading below the bottom.
